version.author: Yeji Jung
version.changelog:
Waveform Reads peaks at screen resolution, so a wide window shows the detail it can hold The centre line runs through silence again Fixed a bar merging across silence and trailing a hairline to the end of the lane
List Drag a header to reorder columns, right-click one to hide it Hidden columns are remembered between sessions
Layout Hide the waveform and the EQ and comp panels for a list-only layout Option to put the waveform above the list Option to keep EQ and comp settings when moving between files
Drag and drop Right-click or Escape cancels a drag in progress Hardened against crashes: ghost items are revalidated every frame, and a selection is clamped to the real file length before anything is placed
Look Simple Dark is now the default Simple's spectral colours show frequency instead of a near-flat grey Rainbow Dark sits on neutral grey so the spectral colours carry Three icon sets: Pixel, Outline and Bulky, now all the same size Fixed no hover highlight in the column menu on Rose and Sage
Setup ReaImGui and SWS are each pointed at the right place when missing A clear message when ReaImGui is older than 0.9, instead of a Lua error

metadata.description:
Reads your existing Media Explorer databases (MediaDB/*.ReaperFileList).
Search: words (AND), OR / comma, NOT / -word, "exact phrase", field:word Tokens: 48k 48k+ 44k- 1ch 2ch+ 24b 16b- 2s 0.5s- 10s+ 3s=
Preview with waveform, range selection, pitch, fit-to-length, EQ and compressor, then spot or drag to the selected track at the edit cursor.
Requires ReaImGui (ReaPack) and the SWS extension (sws-extension.org).
